title: Science and Engineering Apprenticeship Program (SEAP)
organization: U.S. Department of the Navy (Naval STEM)
description: Eight-week paid summer program placing high school sophomores, juniors and seniors in Department of Navy laboratories to take part in real Naval research. About 300 placements across 38 laboratories nationwide; each lab sets its own details, so check the lab pages.

Must be a U.S. citizen (some labs make exceptions for permanent residents and dual citizens)

Check each lab's page for its own eligibility rules
compensation_description: $4,000 for new participants; $4,500 for returning participants

grade.quote: academically talented high school sophomores, juniors, and seniors interested in STEM

schedule.quote: for eight weeks during the summer
